feature: CDR direct record lengths, zero padding and structural integrity

native.implementation: libcdr0.1.9 native Homebrew cdr2raw and cdr2xhtml
native.framing: Native default Letter-page points mapped by declared page center and 1/72 scale to source-declared content-fit inch view. Original native path coordinates and colors independently asserted before mapping. Not whole-page layout fidelity.

rootCause: parseCdrCompressedRecords treated every field as a table index, stopped at zero padding, and silently broke on malformed records or resource limits. Valid direct lengths and padded structures disappeared; corrupt tails produced unqualified partial success.
repair: Resolve in-range table indexes or literal byte lengths, skip permitted zeros, validate every record and list boundary, explicitly fail record/depth limits; retain real independent-thumbnail fallback and host lifecycle guards.
